recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-39270. Treat FHIR-48958 as separate future work to define detailed per-resource variability/source-of-truth policy rather than expanding this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-39270 asked for explicit conformance guidance that canonical resources with the same url and version are materially the same except for logical id, that local usage assertions belong outside the canonical resource, and that resource type + url + version is normally unique with defined multiple-form exceptions.
initial_application: Commit 49b86f8a69 added the main localization guidance and element links for FHIR-39270, but current source still lacked the approved resource type + url + version uniqueness paragraph and neighboring references.html text treated duplicate full-version resources too absolutely as an error.
additional_context: FHIR-47235 later reinforced that local supported/enabled state is not CanonicalResource.status, FHIR-47363 changed version wording to canonical version, and FHIR-52895 expanded canonical matching text in references.html. FHIR-48958 remains Waiting for Input for a broader R6 policy on canonical version uniqueness and per-resource source-of-truth rules, so this change intentionally stays narrow.
reconciliation: Added the missing canonicalresource.html paragraph for same-canonical-version multiple forms and updated references.html so duplicate full-version resources are erroneous when meaning or definition changes, while generated or assembled forms may be legitimate if meaning and definition remain identical.
source_changes: source/canonicalresource/canonicalresource-notes.xml: added the missing paragraph about resource type + canonical URL + version uniqueness and legitimate multiple same-version forms such as ValueSet expansions, generated StructureDefinition snapshots, and assembled/unassembled Questionnaires.

source/references.html: narrowed the duplicate-full-version error guidance to meaning/definition changes and linked legitimate generated or assembled form exceptions back to canonicalresource.html#localization.

related_jiras.note: Implemented in the same 49b86f8a69 commit and explains why CanonicalResource.date was linked to localization guidance.
Implemented in the same 49b86f8a69 commit but concerns topic/jurisdiction deprecation rather than this uniqueness clarification.
Added status guidance consistent with keeping local enabled/supported assertions outside CanonicalResource.status.
Clarified CanonicalResource.version terminology as canonical version, which informed this wording.
Unresolved broader request to define detailed canonical version uniqueness and multiple-form policy; not decided here.
Later canonical version matching guidance in references.html was aligned with FHIR-39270's multiple-form exception.
